QuestInfo.0: Purchase items from the Tempest Shop during the Tempest event period, and you'll be entered into a special event for a chance at great prizes. The more you purchase, the higher your chances of winning!

0.0: #h0#, did you hear about the amazing items you can purchase from the Tempest merchants, Wind and Spark? All you need are Tempest Coins. And that's not all...
0.1: By making purchases from the Tempest Shop, you're given opportunities to submit entries to the ongoing web event for a chance at even more goodies! You'll get one entry for every 3 coins you spend.
0.2: You'll see a list of prizes. All you have to do is select an item you'd love to win and click #bSubmit#k to submit an entry toward that prize. You can check how many entries you've submitted to each prize through the Quest Notifier.
0.3: We'll hold six drawings over the course of six weeks. Once the winner is announced for the first drawing, everything'll reset, and you can submit new entries for the new week.
0.4: If you have more questions, check out details on the MapleStory homepage. Okay, well, I hope you enjoy Tempest!
